scope: Starter dataset: UCI-class and internationally significant velodromes worldwide, plus broad North American coverage. Not exhaustive.
notes: Coordinates are venue-level approximations (typically within ~1 km), which is ample precision for weather/pressure lookups.
elevation_m is ground elevation above sea level from a digital elevation model at the given coordinates; use it to convert between station pressure and sea-level pressure.
track_length_m is null where not confidently known. surface: wood | concrete | asphalt | null.

status: active | uncertain | demolished. 'uncertain' marks venues whose operational status has recently fluctuated - verify before relying on them. 'demolished' venues are retained so historical splits recorded there keep resolving.
Japan's ~40 outdoor keirin tracks (335-500 m) are represented only by a note on the Izu entry.
elevation_source 'estimate' = curated city/venue-level value; the app should refresh these from a DEM service, e.g. GET https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/elevation?latitude={lat}&longitude={lon}
